/* cppi::12a8dc0f80bcd497689ea9a2da99f28aac2d4e3782556990f93e39b54a150d45 */
Select
    Null                                as InstrumentDetails,
    SEC.scd_id                          as ClientInstrumentID,
    SEC.origination_date                as InformationDate,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment = 'True' Then 'Yes'
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment  = 'True' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End                                 as CreditSpreadAdjustmentIsApplicable,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment = 'True' Then CASH_COUPON.colc_spread_adjustment
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment = 'True'  Then PIK_COUPON.colc_spread_adjustment
        Else Null
    End                                 as CreditSpreadAdjustment,
--////////////// START OF THE CASH SECTION //////////////////////////
    Case WHEN CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is null then 'No' Else 'Yes' End as PaysCashInterest,
    Null                                as CashStartDate,
    Null                                as CashEndDate,
    Null                                as CashAccruedAmount,
    Case WHEN CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is null then Null Else
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End End                                 as CashInterestIsFloating,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then CASH_COUPON.colc_index_name
        Else Null
    End                                 as CashBaseRateIndex,   -- Needs translation table
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then 'No' Else
    Case When sched.value_decimal is not null Then 'Yes' 
         Else 'No'
    End End                                 as CashBaseRateIndexIsCappedFloored,
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else
    Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'   Then sched.value_decimal
         Else Null
    End End                                 as CashBaseRateIndexCap,
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else
    Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexFloor' Then sched.value_decimal
         Else Null
    End End                                 as CashBaseRateIndexFloor,
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else 'Fixed' End as CashMarginType,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then CASH_COUPON.colc_spread
        Else CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_rate
    End                                 as CashFixedSpreadAmount,
    Null                                as CashMetric,
    Null                                as CashMetricValueMarginGrid,
    --For Loans default the CashTotalInterestRateIsCappedFloored to No, Null,NUll
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else 'No'  End  as CashTotalInterestRateIsCappedFloored,
    Null                                  as CashTotalInterestRateCap,
    Null                                  as CashTotalInterestRateFloor,
    CASH_COUPON.colc_day_count_name       as CashDayCountConvention, 
--////////////// END OF THE CASH SECTION //////////////////////////    
--*************************************PIK SECTION **************************************************************************
--NEED TO TEST IF A PIK CONTRACT EXISTS AND NULL THIS ENTIRE SECTION IF IT DOES NOT.
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is null then 'No' Else 'Yes' End as PaysPIKInterest,
    Null                                as PIKStartDate,
    Null                                as PIKEndDate,
    Null                                as PIKAccruedAmount,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End End                                 as PIKInterestIsFloating,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_index_name
        Else Null
    End End                                 as PIKBaseRateIndex,   --NEEDS TRANSLATION TABLE
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else 
			Case When sched.value_decimal is not null Then 'Yes' 
	         	 Else 'No'
    End	End    		                         as PIKBaseRateIndexIsCappedFloored,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    		Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'   Then sched.value_decimal
	         Else Null
    End End                                  as PIKBaseRateIndexCap,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    		Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexFloor' Then sched.value_decimal
         	Else Null
    End End                                  as PIKBaseRateIndexFloor,
	Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else 'Fixed' End as PIKMarginType,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_spread
        Else PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_rate
    End End                                 as PIKFixedSpreadAmount,
    Null                                    as PIKMetric,
    Null                                    as PIKMetricValueMarginGrid,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_has_cap_rate   = 'True' or  PIK_COUPON.colc_has_floor_rate = 'True' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateIsCappedFloored,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_has_cap_rate   = 'True' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_cap_rate
        Else Null
    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateCap,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_has_floor_rate = 'True' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_floor_rate
        Else Null
    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateFloor,
    PIK_COUPON.colc_day_count_name          as PIKDayCountConvention     --NEEDS TRANSLATION TABLE
FROM
    reference.ci_sentry_security SEC
    left join (	Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,
					COUP.colc_first_accrual_date, COUP.colc_fixed_rate, COUP.colc_fixed_floating, COUP.colc_spread, COUP.colc_index_name,
					colc_day_count_name, colc_payment_frequency, colc_pay_convention, facility_maturity_date, loan_contract_status,
					COUP.colc_include_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_has_cap_rate,COUP.colc_has_floor_rate,
					COUP.colc_cap_rate,COUP.colc_floor_rate,TRD.quantity_net,COUP.colc_all_in_rate,
					ROW_NUMBER()  OVER( Partition by (COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, loan_contract_currency)
					Order By COUP.security_identifier, COUP.loan_contract_status, COUP.loan_contract_type, TRD.quantity_net desc, COUP.loan_contract_identifier desc ) AS Row
                        --Note The loan_contract_status orders - Active, Matured, Not_Traded.
				From
					reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon COUP
					left join (Select security_identifier,sum(cast( quantity_net as decimal(19,5) )) as quantity_net --This security_identifier is a loan_contract_identifier
								From  trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions
								Where security_type = 'loanContract' and transaction_code in ('ROLL+','ROLL-')
									and transaction_type = 'transaction' and is_cancelled = 'False' and date(trade_date) <= date('2025-06-13')
								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type <> 'PIK'
					and business_date = '2025-06-13'
				) CASH Where Row = 1 AND CASH.quantity_net <> 0	 and CASH.colc_all_in_rate <> 0 
			)	CASH_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = CASH_COUPON.security_identifier
    left join ( Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,
					COUP.colc_first_accrual_date, COUP.colc_fixed_rate, COUP.colc_fixed_floating, COUP.colc_spread, COUP.colc_index_name,
					COUP.colc_day_count_name, COUP.colc_payment_frequency, COUP.colc_pay_convention, COUP.facility_maturity_date, COUP.loan_contract_status,
					COUP.colc_include_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_has_cap_rate,COUP.colc_has_floor_rate,
					COUP.colc_cap_rate,COUP.colc_floor_rate,TRD.quantity_net, COUP.colc_all_in_rate,
					ROW_NUMBER()  OVER( Partition by (COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, loan_contract_currency)
					Order By COUP.security_identifier, COUP.loan_contract_status, COUP.loan_contract_type, TRD.quantity_net desc, COUP.loan_contract_identifier desc ) AS Row
                        --Note The loan_contract_status orders - Active, Matured, Not_Traded.
				From
					reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon COUP
					left join (Select security_identifier,sum(cast(quantity_net as decimal(19,5) ))  as quantity_net --This security_identifier is a loan_contract_identifier
								From  trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions
								Where security_type = 'loanContract' and transaction_code in ('ROLL+','ROLL-')
									and transaction_type = 'transaction' and is_cancelled = 'False' and date(trade_date) <= date('2025-06-13')
								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type = 'PIK'
					and COUP.business_date = '2025-06-13'
				) PIK Where Row = 1	AND PIK.quantity_net <> 0 AND PIK.colc_all_in_rate <> 0	
			) PIK_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = PIK_COUPON.security_identifier
	left join (select sched.* from reference.ci_sentry_security_schedules sched
                    where
                    sched.business_date = '2025-06-13' 
                    and sched.end_date <> '' 
                    and date('2025-06-13') between date(sched.start_date) and date(sched.end_date)
                    and sched.schedule_name in ('CreditFacility_IndexFloor', 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'))  sched on SEC.security_identifier = sched.security_identifier
where
    date('2025-06-13') between date(SEC.start_date) and date(SEC.end_date)

    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateFloor,
    PIK_COUPON.colc_day_count_name          as PIKDayCountConvention     --NEEDS TRANSLATION TABLE
FROM
    reference.ci_sentry_security SEC
    left join (	Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,

				From
					reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon COUP
					left join (Select security_identifier,sum(cast( quantity_net as decimal(19,5) )) as quantity_net --This security_identifier is a loan_contract_identifier
								From  trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions

								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type <> 'PIK'
					and business_date = '2025-06-13'
				) CASH Where Row = 1 AND CASH.quantity_net <> 0	 and CASH.colc_all_in_rate <> 0 
			)	CASH_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = CASH_COUPON.security_identifier
    left join ( Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,
					COUP.colc_first_accrual_date, COUP.colc_fixed_rate, COUP.colc_fixed_floating, COUP.colc_spread, COUP.colc_index_name,

								From  trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions

									and transaction_type = 'transaction' and is_cancelled = 'False' and date(trade_date) <= date('2025-06-13')
								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type = 'PIK'
					and COUP.business_date = '2025-06-13'
				) PIK Where Row = 1	AND PIK.quantity_net <> 0 AND PIK.colc_all_in_rate <> 0	
			) PIK_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = PIK_COUPON.security_identifier
	left join (select sched.* from reference.ci_sentry_security_schedules sched
                    where
                    sched.business_date = '2025-06-13' 
                    and sched.end_date <> '' 
                    and date('2025-06-13') between date(sched.start_date) and date(sched.end_date)
                    and sched.schedule_name in ('CreditFacility_IndexFloor', 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'))  sched on SEC.security_identifier = sched.security_identifier

/* cppi::a70b27cf1c33d110c8f7875a1b9a202c3dcf60cef4525d5f27e9672cee2b78ef */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 11 and 12
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 11:23:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

		COUNT(*) as counter

		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::eb061c7cebab616160298e40396857a5f1c32df0fa7fe82451ac333092ae80b7 */
SELECT * from (
            SELECT from_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end, 8) as mid_price, 
                format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot')
            UNION
            SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
                format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
            Left Join ( 
                SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date
                FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            ) as CAD_Rate on MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
            WHERE MainTable.business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD' and MainTable.mid_price != 0 and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date, from_currency )
    where from_currency = 'EUR'

"interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency", "transaction_cancellation_flag", "reconciliation_status", "created_date", "party_id", "epm_party_name", "transaction_number_in_originating_system", "payment_amount_quotation_currency", "payment_amount_portfolio_currency", "external_short_tag", "settlement_date", "quotation_currency", "number_of_units", "cross_deal_indicator", "settlement_location", "esm_country_code", "country_ref_code", "esm_country_name", "esm_incorp_country_name", "portfolio_group_id", "abor_security_group_name", "abor_security_type_name", "model_portfolio_name", "country_ref_name", "quotation_currency_name", "price_qc", "price_pc", "fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency", "cppib_country_of_exposure_name", "cppib_currency_of_exposure_name", "portfolio_name", "portfolio_group_name", "investment_strategy_name", "investment_department_name", "abor_instrument_type_id", "investment_type_name", "investmentstructurelevel3", "investmentstructurelevel4", "abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency", "abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency", "portfolio_id", "ibor_reason", "abor_coupon_rate", "dividend_per_share", "borrowing_account", "coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency", "restitution_expected_portfolio_currency", "restitution_expected_quotation_currency", "restitution_expected_settlement_currency", "accrued_interest_portfolio_currency", "accrued_interest_quotation_currency", "current_value_portfolio_currency", "current_value_quotation_currency", "additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency", "additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency"
FROM (WITH RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
						order by
							changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        CAST(st.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
        ROUND(st.abor_transaction_number) AS abor_transaction_number,
        st.abor_security_id,
        st.abor_security_number,
        st.abor_security_name,
        st.model_portfolio_id,
        st.portfolio_id,
        st.business_transaction_code,
        st.settlement_currency,
        CAST(st.trade_date AS DATE) AS trade_date,
        CAST(st.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date,
        st.nominal,
        st.nominal_basis,
        st.elementary_transaction_code,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        CAST(CAST(st.created_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.external_short_tag,
        CAST(st.settlement_date AS DATE) AS settlement_date,
        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN (
    	select distinct exchange_name, mic, business_date, country_ref_code
    	from reference.reference_exchange_codes
    	where exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
    ) rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT *,
		    ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number ORDER BY business_date DESC ) AS latest
		FROM (
			SELECT abor_transaction_number,
				business_date,
				transaction_cancellation_flag,
				trade_date,
				MAX(abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Cost' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
				MAX(abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Cost' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
		 	FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
		 	GROUP BY abor_transaction_number,
		    	business_date,
		    	transaction_cancellation_flag,
		    	trade_date
		    )
    ) stc
        ON stc.latest = 1
        AND stc.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
        AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
        AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
        AND st.cost_or_tax_present = 'Yes'
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM JoinedData
WHERE rn = 1
AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active') AS "transactions_base"

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key

        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,

    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number

        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT *,

		FROM (
			SELECT abor_transaction_number,

		 	FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost

	WHERE

WITH
    re_index_weights AS (
        SELECT 'ENHG' AS index_prefix, 1 AS weight
    )

SELECT
    'RE SA'                                 AS "Portfolio",
    constituent.business_date               AS "Business Date",
    constituent.security_name               AS "Security Name",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(constituent.bloomberg_ticker, '') = '' THEN '' 
        ELSE CONCAT(constituent.bloomberg_ticker, ' Equity') 
    END                                     AS "Bloomberg Ticker", 
    constituent.id_isin_eod                 AS "ISIN",
    constituent.id_sedol_eod                AS "SEDOL",
    constituent.id_cppib_index              AS "CPPIB Index Id",
    weight.weight                           AS "Index Weight",
    constituent.weight_eod                  AS "Constituent Weight",
    weight.weight * constituent.weight_eod  AS "Weight"
FROM market.cppib_index_constituent constituent
INNER JOIN re_index_weights weight
   ON SUBSTR(constituent.id_cppib_index, 1, POSITION('_' IN constituent.id_cppib_index) - 1) = weight.index_prefix
WHERE business_date >= Date('2024-03-29')
  AND id_cppib_index LIKE 'ENHG%'
ORDER BY business_date,
         id_cppib_index,
         bloomberg_ticker

	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 06 and 07
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 06:53:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	shm.portfolio_id,

	shm.quotation_currency_code,

left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security

	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number

	from reference.scd_portfolio

	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'

	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)

	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)

	from trades_deals.irs_trades

	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

	shm.portfolio_id,

	shm.quotation_currency_code,

left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security

	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number

	from reference.scd_portfolio

	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'

	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)

	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)

	from trades_deals.irs_trades

	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

	shm.portfolio_id,

	shm.quotation_currency_code,

left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security

	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number

	from reference.scd_portfolio

	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'

	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)

	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)

	from trades_deals.irs_trades

	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

FROM (select 
    es.security_name_id,
	shm.abor_security_id,
	es.sedol,
	rcc.country_name,
	asi.incorp_country_code, 
	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	shm.model_portfolio_id,
	shm.balance_nominal_number,
	ss.abor_security_type_id,
	es.isin,
	cast(shm.business_date as date) as business_date,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	shm.portfolio_id,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	shm.quotation_currency_name,
	shm.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_price clean_price_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_price * shm.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency clean_price_portfolio_currency,
	shm.clean_value_portfolio_currency,
	es.esm_country_code,
	rcc_esm.country_name as esm_country_name,
	es.esm_incorp_country_code,
	rcc_incorp_country.country_name as esm_incorp_country_name,
	rec.country_ref_code,
	rcc_trade_country.country_name as country_ref_name,
	smp.investment_strategy_name,
	smp.investment_department_name,
	spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
	spif.investmentstructurelevel4,
	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	shm.balance_book_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency,
	shm.quotation_currency_code,
	shm.dirty_price,
	shm.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency,
	shm.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	shm.abor_security_number,
	es.cppib_sec_id,
	ss_ul.abor_security_id as underlying_security_id,
	ss_ul.isin_id as underlying_isin,
	ss_ul.sedol_id as underlying_sedol,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	es.esm_next_coupon_date,
	it.first_calculation_period_start_date,
	shm.balance_transaction_costs_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
	shm.balance_transaction_costs_portfolio_currency,
	shm.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency,
	shm.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency,
	shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.next_dividend_quotation_currency,
	shm.next_coupon_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_nominal_number_unsettled,
		-- New issuer_country_code field
	case 
	    when shm.abor_security_type_id in ('FUT_EQT','FUT_BOND','FUT_IR', 'FUT_COMDTY') then es.esm_country_code
	    when shm.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' then null
	    else ss.abor_country_id 
	end as issuer_country_code
from holdings.scd_holdings_main shm
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
) sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten spif
	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc
	on rcc.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and asi.incorp_country_code = rcc.country_code
left join reference.scd_securities ss_ul
	on cast(ss_ul.scd_security_key_id as varchar) = es.esm_underlying_instrument_id 
	and cast(ss_ul.business_date as date) = es.business_date
	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_esm
	on rcc_esm.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by id_instrument order by business_date desc) latest
	from trades_deals.irs_trades
) it
	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

      ld.business_date, 
      ld.limit_id, 
      ld.limit_name, 
      ld.limit_description, 
      ld.limit_status, 
      ld.limit_type,

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 15 and 16
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 15:26:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE

		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

WITH

    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
          AND trans.model_portfolio_id in (
--              'RIPREI1A','RIPREI2A','RIPREI1E','RIPREI2E'
              'MPINFRA1D','MPINFRA1E','MPINFRA2D','MPINLCP1D'
--              'MPSEG1D','MPSEG1E'
          )
          AND trans.elementary_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyRaloc','Sell','SellRaloc')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-03-20')
    ),

    latest_equity AS (
        SELECT equity.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
                ORDER BY last_updated_date_time DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM asset.asset_equity equity
    )

SELECT
    'Listed RE'                                             AS "Portfolio",
--    'Listed Infra'                                          AS "Portfolio",
--    'Listed SEG'                                            AS "Portfolio",
    trans.abor_security_id                                  AS "Full Ticker",
    trans.trade_date                                        AS "Trade Date",
    trans.settlement_date                                   AS "Settle Date",
    trans.quotation_currency                                AS "Currency",
    CASE
        WHEN trans.elementary_transaction_code = 'BuyRaloc'  THEN 'Buy'
        WHEN trans.elementary_transaction_code = 'SellRaloc' THEN 'Sell'
    END                                                     AS "Transaction Type",
    SUM(CAST(trans.nominal AS INTEGER))                     AS "Size",
    SUM(trans.nominal * trans.price) / SUM(trans.nominal)   AS "Avg Fill Price",
    equity.bloomberg_unique_id                              AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    equity.isin                                             AS "ISIN - Current"
FROM latest_trans trans
LEFT JOIN latest_equity equity
       ON equity.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange = trans.abor_security_id
	  AND equity.rn = 1
WHERE trans.rn = 1
GROUP BY trans.abor_security_id,
         trans.trade_date,
         trans.settlement_date,
         trans.quotation_currency,
         trans.elementary_transaction_code,
         equity.bloomberg_unique_id,
         equity.isin
ORDER BY trans.abor_security_id,
         trans.trade_date

	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn

	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1

	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss

	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number

	from reference.scd_portfolio

	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio

	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)

	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)

	from trades_deals.irs_trades

	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn

	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1

	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss

	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number

	from reference.scd_portfolio

	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio

	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)

	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)

	from trades_deals.irs_trades

	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

SELECT "t3"."x_measure__0" AS "temp_02_net_pv__co",
  0 AS "temp_calculation_2",
  "t0"."temp_calculation_1" AS "temp_calculation_1",
  "t0"."temp_short_pv_new_" AS "temp_short_pv_new_",
  "t3"."x_measure__1" AS "temp_short_pv_new1",
  "t3"."x_measure__0" AS "sum_01_calculated1",
  "t0"."sum_01_calculated_" AS "sum_01_calculated_"
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(1) AS "temp_calculation_1",
    SUM("rmv_position"."future_cashflow_base") AS "temp_short_pv_new_",
    SUM((CASE WHEN ("rmv_position"."long_short" = 'SHORT') THEN (CASE WHEN ("rmv_position"."product_group" = 'Equity Swap') THEN (CASE WHEN ((CAST(CAST("rmv_position"."maturity_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)) AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" = 0)) THEN "rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" WHEN ((CAST(CAST("rmv_position"."maturity_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)) AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" <> 0)) THEN 0. ELSE ("rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" + "rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy") END) WHEN (("rmv_position"."product_group" = 'Convertible Bond') AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" = 0)) THEN 0. WHEN (("rmv_position"."product_group" = 'Convertible Bond') AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" <> 0)) THEN "rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" ELSE "rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" END) ELSE 0. END)) AS "sum_01_calculated_",
    COUNT(1) AS "x__alias__0"
  FROM "risk_prod"."rmv_position" "rmv_position"
  WHERE (("rmv_position"."investment_dept" = 'Active Equities') AND (CAST(CAST("rmv_position"."business_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)) AND ("rmv_position"."investment_strat" = 'AE Enhanced Beta') AND ("rmv_position"."portfolio_type" = 'IP') AND ("rmv_position"."product_group" IN ('Public Equity Direct', 'Synthetic Equity Index')))
  HAVING (COUNT(1) > 0)
) "t0"
  INNER JOIN (
  SELECT SUM("t2"."x_measure__2") AS "x_measure__0",
    SUM("t2"."x_measure__3") AS "x_measure__1",
    COUNT(1) AS "x__alias__1"
  FROM (
    SELECT "rmv_position"."business_date" AS "business_date",
      "rmv_position"."position_key" AS "position_key"
    FROM "risk_prod"."rmv_position" "rmv_position"
    WHERE ((CAST(CAST("rmv_position"."business_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)) AND ("rmv_position"."investment_dept" = 'Active Equities') AND ("rmv_position"."investment_strat" = 'AE Enhanced Beta') AND ("rmv_position"."portfolio_type" = 'IP') AND ("rmv_position"."product_group" IN ('Public Equity Direct', 'Synthetic Equity Index')))
    GROUP BY "rmv_position"."business_date",
      "rmv_position"."position_key"
  ) "t1"
    INNER JOIN (
    SELECT "rmv_position"."business_date" AS "business_date",
      "rmv_position"."position_key" AS "position_key",
      AVG((CASE WHEN ("rmv_position"."long_short" = 'LONG') THEN (CASE WHEN ("rmv_position"."product_group" = 'Equity Swap') THEN (CASE WHEN ((CAST(CAST("rmv_position"."maturity_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)) AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" = 0)) THEN "rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" WHEN ((CAST(CAST("rmv_position"."maturity_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)) AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" <> 0)) THEN 0. ELSE ("rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" + "rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy") END) WHEN (("rmv_position"."product_group" = 'Convertible Bond') AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" = 0)) THEN 0. WHEN (("rmv_position"."product_group" = 'Convertible Bond') AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" <> 0)) THEN "rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" ELSE "rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" END) ELSE 0. END)) AS "x_measure__2",
      AVG((CASE WHEN ("rmv_position"."long_short" = 'SHORT') THEN (CASE WHEN ("rmv_position"."product_group" = 'Equity Swap') THEN (CASE WHEN ((CAST(CAST("rmv_position"."maturity_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)) AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" = 0)) THEN "rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" WHEN ((CAST(CAST("rmv_position"."maturity_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)) AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" <> 0)) THEN 0. ELSE ("rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" + "rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy") END) WHEN (("rmv_position"."product_group" = 'Convertible Bond') AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" = 0)) THEN 0. WHEN (("rmv_position"."product_group" = 'Convertible Bond') AND ("rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" <> 0)) THEN "rmv_position"."abacus_notional_base_ccy" ELSE "rmv_position"."abacus_pv_base_ccy" END) ELSE 0. END)) AS "x_measure__3"
    FROM "risk_prod"."rmv_position" "rmv_position"
    WHERE ("rmv_position"."investment_dept" = 'Active Equities')
    GROUP BY "rmv_position"."business_date",
      "rmv_position"."position_key"
  ) "t2" ON (("t1"."business_date" = "t2"."business_date") AND ((COALESCE("t1"."position_key", '0') = COALESCE("t2"."position_key", '0')) AND (COALESCE("t1"."position_key", '1') = COALESCE("t2"."position_key", '1'))))
  HAVING (COUNT(1) > 0)

with old_breached_records as (

        limit_id,

    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id

    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),

    select *

    union all

        )
    group by limit_name,

),

    union all
    select *

/* cppi::0e2b5ff938c143d335305fa7420a839c1036678ed08fe24561745865418b7b18 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 07 and 08
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 07:58:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::b7dcc59f22f6858b1342e7752537206c7ba409851aed2161ee482df0fac23f13 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 00 and 01
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 00:15:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc

			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'

					, 'IPN_S'

			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll'

			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_fytd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc

			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd

			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll

		  ]

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

/* QuickSight 43f74fa7-13b3-4187-99a8-5f4d36f89054 */

			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'

		, last_update

			, time_weighted_return_lc

			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from

				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'

				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'

				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id

			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc

			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'

	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'

			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx'

			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd'

			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll'

			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_fytd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc

		  ]
